_comment: Manual cross-region fare uplift. Edit, save, restart the app. No Colab re-export needed. Same region at BOTH ends is always 0%.
_regions: CENTRAL = Dhaka + surrounding districts | PADMA = Barishal/Khulna/Faridpur side | JAMUNA = Rajshahi/Rangpur side | MEGHNA = Chattogram/Cumilla side | SYLHET = Sylhet side
_rule_note: destination = use the DROPOFF region's percentage (directional). max = use the higher of the two regions' percentages (symmetric). Same region at both ends is 0% under either rule.
_pair_pct_note: THE LIVE RULE. "A|B" applies in both directions; "A>B" would apply to that direction only. A region listed against ITSELF (e.g. "CENTRAL|CENTRAL") marks up trips that start and end inside that region -- without such an entry, same-region trips are always 0%. CENTRAL|MEGHNA is 0 for now -- change the number to switch it on.
_region_pct_note: Fallback for a cross-region trip NOT listed in pair_pct. All zero, so only the pairs below are marked up.
_car_pct_note: Flat markup per vehicle class, applied on EVERY route (same region or not). Add other car types here as needed.
_combine_note: How region and car markups stack when both apply. add = 20 + 13 = 33%. compound = 1.20 x 1.13 = 35.6%. max = 20% (car only tops up).
_rules_note: Conditional adjustments, ADDED on top of region + car. Negative pct = discount. Conditions you can use: trip_type (one_way/round_way), car_types (list), min_km / max_km (total_km; round trips cover BOTH legs), regions (list; matches if EITHER end is in it). Omit a condition to skip checking it.
_floor_note: Lowest final percentage allowed, so discounts have room. cap is the upper limit.
